WITH VentasPorFactura AS (
    SELECT
        idCliente,
        NumFactura,
        idTiempo,
        SUM(Subtotal) AS TotalFactura
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://motorepdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/motoreparchivos/Olap/Hechos/Ventas',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS v
    GROUP BY
        idCliente,
        NumFactura,
        idTiempo
),
Encuestas AS (
    SELECT
        idCliente,
        idTiempo,
        SatisfaccionGeneral
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://motorepdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/motoreparchivos/Olap/Hechos/Encuestas',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS e
)
SELECT
    v.idTiempo / 10000 AS Anio,
    (v.idTiempo / 100) % 100 AS Mes,
    e.SatisfaccionGeneral AS NivelSatisfaccion,
    SUM(v.TotalFactura) AS TotalVentas,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.NumFactura) AS CantidadFacturas
FROM VentasPorFactura v
INNER JOIN Encuestas e
    ON v.idCliente = e.idCliente
    AND v.idTiempo = e.idTiempo
GROUP BY
    v.idTiempo / 10000,
    (v.idTiempo / 100) % 100,
    e.SatisfaccionGeneral
ORDER BY
    Anio,
    Mes,
    NivelSatisfaccion;
